title: Headache threshold lower today?
caption: Headache threshold lower today? Focus may come in quick bursts and then dip, so keep things simple. Pace tasks, pause every 45–60 minutes for slow breathing, and dim screens as evening nears to help you settle.

affects: Headache and migraine sensitivity may be a bit higher for some. Focus can come in short bursts with quicker dips. Mood and patience might feel frayed at times for people already sensitive.
playbook:
- Pause every 45–60 minutes for slow breathing
- Lower screen brightness in the evening
- Try gentle neck stretches if pressure builds
- Stay hydrated and rest sooner if needed

fb.caption: Headache threshold lower today? You might notice focus arriving in quick bursts and then dipping, and patience wearing thin faster than usual. That matters because those short attention windows make sustained work feel harder and tension can build if you push through without breaks. Try pacing tasks into short chunks, pause every 45–60 minutes for slow breathing and a gentle neck stretch, and dim screens toward evening so your nervous system can settle — giving your internal router a moment to reconnect.
